method.geometry: WGS84 ECEF to ENU; no atmospheric refraction. Geometric altitude preferred when present in the trace; otherwise barometric altitude (pressure altitude, not true height).
method.trace_time: Absolute time = JSON 'timestamp' (unix seconds) + per-point offset seconds, per readsb README-json.md.
method.coverage_caveat: This is a volunteer ADS-B/MLAT archive. Aircraft without a transponder, with ADS-B off, or outside receiver coverage (including some military flights) may be absent. Absence of a trace is not evidence that no aircraft was present.
